item.title: Biwaichi: Cycling Around Lake Biwa — Guide
item.description: Biwaichi, literally ‘once around Biwa’, is one of Japan’s great cycling pilgrimages: a full lap of Lake Biwa’s shoreline, roughly 200 kilometres on the classic route, designated a National Cycle Route and marked throughout with the blue arrows and distance countdowns that make it navigable without a map. The mostly flat course rolls past lakeside torii, pine beaches, reed marshes and mountain backdrops, with the quieter, more scenic northern half often ridden alone as a 150 km ‘short lap’.
